title: FRInGe: Distribution-Space Integrated Gradients with Fisher--Rao Geometry
abstract: arXiv:2605.06404v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Although gradient-based attribution methods are model-faithful and scalable, a prominent variant, Integrated Gradients (IG), suffers from high sensitivity to design choices, particularly in baseline selection, path formulation, and discretization, as well as gradient saturation. To address these limitations, we propose Fisher--Rao Integrated Gradients (FRInGe), which defines both the reference and integration paths in the predictive distribution space. FRInGe replaces input baselines with a maximum-entropy predictive reference and follows a Fisher--Rao geodesic on the probability simplex. The corresponding input-space trajectory is realized through the pullback Fisher metric and stabilized by Kullback--Leibler (KL) and Euclidean trust regions; attributions are obtained by integrating input gradients along this trajectory. translated_title: FRInGe：基于Fisher-Rao几何的分布空间积分梯度
translated_abstract: 尽管基于梯度的归因方法具有模型忠实性和可扩展性，但其一个著名变体——积分梯度- 对设计选择高度敏感，特别是在基线选择、路径构造和离散化方面，同时还存在梯度饱和问题。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了Fisher-Rao积分梯度（FRInGe），该方法在预测分布空间中同时定义参考点和积分路径。FRInGe用最大熵预测参考替代输入基线，并遵循概率单纯形上的Fisher-Rao测地线。相应的输入空间轨迹通过拉回Fisher度量实现，并由Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度和欧几里得信任域加以稳定；归因结果通过沿该轨迹积分输入梯度获得。我们进一步推导了FRInGe-B变体，该变体将预测概率分布二值化，从而消除了计算（摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: 提出FRInGe方法，将积分梯度的参考点和积分路径定义在预测分布空间中，利用Fisher-Rao几何构造测地线路径，解决了传统积分梯度对设计选择高度敏感和梯度饱和的问题。
en_tdlr: FRInGe reformulates Integrated Gradients in the predictive distribution space using Fisher-Rao geometry, replacing input baselines with a maximum-entropy reference and following geodesic paths to overcome sensitivity to design choices and gradient saturation.
